title: Document Chunk Metadata
description: Metadata for a text chunk stored in Qdrant payload and PostgreSQL during ingestion.

company_id.description: Company scope for multi-tenant retrieval filtering.

section.description: Heading or section title within the source document.

page.description: 1-based page number in the source PDF.

chunk_index.description: Sequential index of this chunk within the document.

version.description: Policy version copied from parent document metadata.

status.description: Mirrors document status; archived chunks excluded from retrieval.

token_count.description: Token count of chunk text using the project's tokenizer.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model used when this chunk was indexed, e.g. text-embedding-3-small.

text_preview.description: Optional truncated chunk text for debugging and eval (omit in production logs if sensitive).
